about.en: Kakao Corp. is a South Korean internet company whose services include the KakaoTalk messenger, KakaoMap, Kakao Gift and Kakao Makers commerce, the Daum portal and a range of AI products. 035720 represents its common shares listed on the Korea Exchange, the code its own investor-relations site publishes as its KOSPI code, and derivative markets quote those shares under the KAKAO ticker.
